title: Banks Act Guidance Note 8/2008 — FATF Enhanced Scrutiny and UN Sanctions (Proliferation)
enablingLegislation: Section 6(5) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The purpose of this guidance note is to inform all banks and controlling companies of the call
made by the Financial Action Task Force ("FATF") for enhanced scrutiny of transactions with
certain jurisdictions and of United Nations sanctions in relation to the proliferation of weapons of
mass destruction.

sections.heading: Guidance on call made by FATF
sections.text:
Enclosed hereto please find a copy of a letter from the Director of the Financial Intelligence
Centre setting out the background and details of the call by FATF for enhanced scrutiny of
transactions with certain jurisdictions and of the United Nations sanctions in relation to the
proliferation of weapons of mass destruction for your information and adoption.

sections.heading: Acknowledgement of receipt
sections.text:
Two additional copies of this guidance note are enclosed for the use of your institution's
independent auditors. The attached acknowledgement of receipt, duly completed and
signed by both the chief executive officer of the institution and the said auditors, should be
returned to this Office at the earliest convenience of the aforementioned signatories.
Registrar of Banks
The previous guidance note issued was Guidance Note 7/2008, dated 7 May 2008.
